title: Debug: Round-Robin Arbiter
constraints: Intended behavior: the round-robin arbiter of problem 28. Registered one-hot grant. The search starts at a pointer, and after granting requester i the pointer moves to i + 1. With no request, `grant = 0` and the pointer stays.
The starter has **2 bugs**: one breaks fairness (a requester can be starved), one leaves a stale grant around.
hints: Let all four request continuously. Does the grant rotate, or does one requester win over and over?
Drop all requests. What should `grant` show in the next cycle?
Starvation bugs rarely show up in short directed tests. That's why the random test matters.
